findings.source_quote: It is said that he seemed to be always praying, always preaching, always visiting the sick, always teaching and instructing, always writing or studying. A friend once reported, "Many times I thought he would have flown out of the pulpit when he came to speak of Jesus Christ."
findings.suggested_fix: Translate both the descriptive sentence and the friend's reported quotation into Afrikaans, preserving punctuation and structure. Example: Daar word gesê hy het altyd gebid, altyd gepreek, altyd die siekes besoek, altyd geleer en onderrig gegee, altyd geskryf of gestudeer. 'n Vriend het eens berig: "Dikwels het ek gedink hy sou uit die preekstoel uitgeswaai het wanneer hy van Jesus Christus praat."

source.html — paragraph with Rutherford's dying testimony (near end, long

findings.source_quote: Late in the afternoon of the last day of his life in answer to the question, "What think ye now of Christ?" answered thusly, "Oh, that all my brethren in the land may know what a Master I have served, and what peace I have this day! I shall sleep in Christ, and when I awake, I shall be satisfied with His likeness. This night shall close the door, and put my anchor within the veil, and I shall go away in a sleep by five of the clock in the morning. Glory! glory to my Creator and my Redeemer forever! I Shall live and adore Him. Oh, for arms to embrace Him! Oh, for a well-tuned harp! Glory! glory dwelleth in Immanuel's land!" These words were heard by his wife, daughter and friends, and he was indeed with his Lord by five in the morning.
findings.suggested_fix: Translate the entire question-and-answer and the following sentence into Afrikaans as a single quoted passage where appropriate. Preserve quotation marks, sentence order and HTML tags. Example replacement (condensed for style): Laatmiddag op die laaste dag van sy lewe, toe gevra is: "Wat dink julle nou van Christus?", het hy geantwoord: "O, dat al my broeders in die land sou weet watter Meester ek gedien het, en watter vrede ek hierdie dag het! Ek sal in Christus slaap, en wanneer ek ontwaak sal ek met Sy beeld bevredig wees. Hierdie nag sal die deur toemaak en my anker binne die voorhangsel sit, en ek sal teen vyfuur in die oggend in 'n slaap weggaan. Heerlikheid! heerlikheid aan my Skepper en my Verlosser vir ewig! Ek sal leef en Hom aanbid. O, vir arms om Hom te omhels! O, vir 'n welgestemde harp! Heerlikheid! heerlikheid woon in Immanuel se land!" Hierdie woorde is deur sy vrou, dogter en vriende gehoor, en hy was inderdaad by vyfuur in die oggend by sy Here.
